text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10-CM code for influenza varies depending on whether the influenza virus is identified and the presence of other manifestations. Common codes include J10 for influenza due to other identified influenza virus and J11 for influenza due to unidentified influenza virus. Within those categories, more specific codes are used based on whether pneumonia or other respiratory, gastrointestinal, or other manifestations are present.
